_comment: Machine source for RNVizion identity facts, the sibling of engine/brand.py. Brand tokens are colors and type; these are the facts about the person and the products. Same rule applies: import it, never hardcode. Change a fact HERE first, then run refresh_profile.py --all to find every surface that disagrees. ARCHIVES: docs/eval-history/ preserves dated eval reports and must keep retired phrases verbatim. Exempting each phrase individually does not scale -- every future retirement will fail there again -- so the durable fix is an archive path exclusion in the checker, alongside SELF_EXCLUDE. The per-file exemptions below are the interim.

identity._comment: Contact and handles. Byte-identical everywhere they appear.
identity.name: Christian Smith

role._comment: Current employment. Tracked because it appears on six surfaces and WILL change; when it does, the old title goes straight into retired[].
role.title: AR/VR Sales & Support Specialist

tagline._comment: The one-line positioning. Variants are allowed and expected; the checker looks for the stem, not the whole sentence, so a page can extend it without failing.
tagline.canonical: Building production AI systems, and the developer tools they run on.

bio._comment: The standing author bio. Ships on every post; must match /bio/.
bio.canonical: is a Python developer building production AI systems on the Claude API, an AR/VR Sales & Support Specialist at Meta, and a self-described modern-day Renaissance man. He ships retrieval systems, LLM agents, and the developer tools they run on; he also writes fiction, makes art, builds things by hand, and is figuring out the rest as he goes.

facts._comment: Values on more than one surface that have drifted before. 'sources' are files the checker reads; 'appears_in' is the wider map including surfaces it cannot reach. 'match' is the literal phrase that must appear on those sources -- a bare value is a useless needle ("60" matches a CSS font weight), so where a fact is printed inside a phrase, give the phrase. MOVE 'match' WITH 'value': a stale match fails loudly on the next run, which is correct but surprising if you forget the pairing.

projects.note: Stat block and the count of project articles must agree.

derive.note: Cross-checked two ways: <article class="project"> count in index.html, and the length of products[].

tests.note: og-image.png is generated from this; never typed twice.

derive.note: Source 'def test_' count is a floor: parametrized tests expand at runtime. The checker verifies the displayed floor is actually supported by source, and says when the next rung on the ladder has been earned. SUBSET: rnv-publishing-agent and rnv-brand are not counted, so the floor is conservative by construction. Adding a repo to this list requires recomputing floor_observed in the same change.

tests._comment: Public surfaces carry a floor that steps in 5k increments, not an exact count. The exact figure came from a CI run and cannot be re-derived without running every suite; the floor can be, from source. Move the display to the next rung only when the source floor clears it.

eval_cases.note: Total only on public surfaces; the split is never published. A trap flipping out_of_corpus -> in_corpus on publication moves the split without moving the total, so the split fails the publication test and lives here as a machine-checked fact instead.

derive.note: Exactly derivable: one JSON object per line, each carrying a 'kind'. Frozen at 60 by decision 2026-08-05; update split in the same commit as any trap flip.

eval_thresholds._comment: The three gates. Declared in rnv-ask-the-corpus/eval/thresholds.json and quoted on the resume; the checker verifies the two agree.

products._comment: The three-layer naming rule as data. display = product name, repo = slug, deployment = platform ID. Where they diverge, the reason is recorded so nobody 'corrects' it later.
products.exempt_reason: The live URL is printed on resumes already in circulation, and Hugging Face Space IDs cannot redirect. Note the stutter argument (rnvizion-rnv-ask-the-corpus.hf.space) is NOT load-bearing: rnv-color-mcp deploys as RNVizion/rnv-color-mcp and carries the same stutter deliberately. Breaking a live URL is the reason; aesthetics are not.

Renamed 2026-07-28 to follow the RNV [Noun] rule.

Apache-2.0 reference implementation. Never 'open standard' or 'open proposal'.

repos._comment: Every repo the checker knows how to fetch and check with --all. 'checks' selects which groups apply; a library repo has no bio to check.

exempt.reason: NOTICE states AIII interoperates with open standards including MCP and IETF/WIMSE. Composing on standards is not claiming to be one. DO NOT DELETE on a 'covers nothing' warning: the phrase IS present in NOTICE (line 6, 'open standards'), verified 2026-08-05. A zero-use ledger entry here means the scanner is not reading the file -- NOTICE is extensionless -- not that the phrase is gone. Deleting it would remove a real exemption that fires the moment the scanner is fixed.
The res-count case note names it. A note field, not matched against retrieval. This is the case the 'Honest and Wrong' essay is built on; editing it destroys the evidence.
